title: CE-RISE Material Profile Data Model
description: Core data model for Digital Material Passports (DMPs) defining material identity via chemical identifiers (CAS, InChI, InChIKey, SMILES), specification codes, commodity codes, and batch traceability. Includes supplier information, import/export compliance, and material specifications (composition, purity, physical/mechanical/thermal/ chemical properties, fingerprinting, and test conditions). Integrates standard ontologies (ChEBI, ChemInf, CAS, UNSPSC, QUDT, EMMO, PATO, CHMO, OBI, Schema.org, GS1).
